name: Soft Scrambled Eggs
steps: Beat the eggs with the milk and salt until uniform.
Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over low-medium heat.
Pour in the eggs; wait a few seconds, then stir slowly with a spatula.
Keep folding the curds gently; pull off the heat while still slightly wet.
Residual heat finishes them — serve immediately.
notes: Low heat and constant gentle stirring keep them soft. Season at the end for the fluffiest result.
